build_yolox_tiny_model: build a YOLOX Tiny object detection model config inheriting from YOLOX Small with reduced backbone depth and width
configure_train_pipeline: configure a YOLOX training pipeline with Mosaic augmentation, RandomAffine, HSV color augmentation, and Resize
configure_test_pipeline: configure a YOLOX test pipeline with Resize to 416x416, padding to square, and annotation loading
setup_dataloaders: setup train, val, and test dataloaders using the configured train and test pipelines for COCO dataset
configure_model_architecture: configure YOLOX Tiny model architecture with deepen_factor 0.33, widen_factor 0.375, and 96-channel features
